label: Azure: 05 Device twin X.509
info: Direct IoT Hub device-twin access with X.509. Can run outside Edge. Requires externally configured identity, certificate chain and key; no Module Client or routes.

name: Start here: direct X.509 DEVICE identity
info: No Module Client or Edge workload required. Before starting Node-RED, configure IOTEDGE_IOTHUBHOSTNAME, IOTEDGE_DEVICEID, PATH_TO_CERTIFICATE_FILE and PATH_TO_KEY_FILE (README). Provision/trust the device certificate in IoT Hub and mount readable PEM certificate/key files read-only. Never paste keys into this flow. Use only one Device Client for this device identity, with no competing process. Deploy, inspect desired properties, change a desired property in IoT Hub, then press Report device state and verify reported.deviceStatus on the DEVICE twin. No message routes are required. Startup/config errors may only appear in logs; Catch is not a replacement. Review Debug output before production use.
